text:
Maria V: Quick sync — Kestrel on-prem activation tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Need final owner lanes for egress/NAT, cert chain status, and CR numbers. Who's owning what? @Samir @Jia @Omar
Samir K: I can own egress/NAT. current blocker: customer firewall team wants outbound ports locked. I've got a ticket with their netops (KNET-88).
Jia L: I'll own certs. Found a chain mismatch on their intermediate CA; asking them to re-issue. ETA ~4h if they push today.
Omar R: Customer readiness update: they confirmed DB access and node prep. Ops has a maintenance window 08:30-10:30 PDT — we need to avoid CRs during that window.
Maria V: Nice. Can you paste the CR numbers? We need them in the cutover doc.
Samir K: CR for NAT rules is CR-2137. Firewall ticket KNET-88 (they just replied, see below).
Jia L: Cert request submitted as CR-2140. They said their CA will re-issue by EOD.
Samir K: Note: fallback plan if outbound blocked — we can route through our egress proxy in us-west-2 for the canary. Need approval from @eng-sre.
Maria V: @eng-sre — can we get a 2hr exception for proxy route during canary? Otherwise we'll miss SLA.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for Kestrel onprem at 09:15 PDT — canary=3 nodes. (triggered by maria_v)
Lina S (Eng-SRE): OK to open proxy exception for the canary window. Adding CR SRE-800. Will monitor the egress metrics and tcp resets.
Omar R: Customer asked about cert fingerprint check — Jia, can you provide the expected SHA256 so they can verify before we start?
Jia L: Expected cert fingerprint (SHA256):
```
3f:ab:9d:4c:2e:1a:5b:6c:7d:8e:9f:aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:00:aa:bb:cc:c7
```
Maria V: Perfect. I'm updating cutover doc and the runbook with CR refs and the fingerprint. Final ask — owners confirm on-call during 09:00-11:00 PDT.
Samir K: I'll be on-call 08:30-10:00.
Jia L: I'll be on-call 09:00-11:00.
Lina S (Eng-SRE): SRE coverage 08:30-11:30, will keep an eye on proxy and kv-cache errors.
Maria V: Great :thumbsup: I'll post final checklist in the repo and ping customer. If anything changes, drop updates here and I'll reroute the deploy.
